reviews.t: Comfy, and affordable. Well made product.
reviews.x: I love that it’s comfortable, dries quick, has a hook to hang it up and has a cute pattern.

reviews.t: Dries super fast! No chance for mold!
reviews.x: This pillow is awesome! It’s comfortable, and has 6 suctions cups so it stays put so long as you don’t use a lot of oil on your bath. It dries fast and even has a hook to hang it up to dry faster. Very impressed!

reviews.t: Review of use in a very upright tub
reviews.x: I have a very upright tub with a narrow ledge and was looking for something with some low back support. My previous bath pillow, which was one of the inflatable shell shaped ones, I would turn upside down so that I could recline in the tub against the very steep wall. This doesnt give the exact support I wanted but was the closest thing I could find; I couldn’t find any pillow with that upside-down-wedge shape. The suction cups on the top do not hold very well because the ledge is so narrow that

reviews.t: I can relax deeper while taking a bath.
reviews.x: I can relax deeper with it in the bathtub, no more hard bathtub wall against my spine and it supports and cushions my neck. The 6 suction cups keep it stuck so it doesn't float away. But since I need to add oils to my baths because I have very dry skin, I have to put it in the washer to get the oils off.

I needed a new bath pillow to cover the spots where the jets in my Jacuzzi tub poke into my back and this one is perfect. It's easy to install and remove, and I love that it has a hook right on it so I can hang it up when I'm done. Overall, very happy with this.

I’m a busy mom of kids under the age of 2. For me, my nightly bath is almost a sacred ritual. After I put my kids to sleep and can mentally clock out, the first thing I often do is draw a bath. I purchased this bath pillow to replace a stiff vinyl one I had been using that had started cracking even though I hadn’t had it very long. I love the soft mesh fabric. It seems both easy to clean and durable. The design of this pillow allows you to fold it over the top of the tub or use it more submerged
Literal piece of garbage. Doesn’t suction for longer than 20 seconds and itchy fabric. 100% WOULD NOT RECOMMEND.

reviews.t: love the feel and the suction - hope it really is mold-resistant - will find out
reviews.x: this pillow feels luxurious and light - more like fabric and less heavy than other more "rubbery" ones I've had before.  this means I love the feel, that I can adjust it in the tub to where I want the most support.  Also, I'm able to 'store' it on my shower walls, rather than leaving it stuck to the lip of the bathtub (which I'm guessing will lead to less mold build-up.)  I live out in the country, so mold just happens, periodically.  I'd LOVE it if this pillow did not invite mold as much as oth

Previously i had a bath pillow that i used for years!  It started to discolor on the back so i ordered a new one (this one) and threw my other away.  I have been using this  new bath pillow for about a month, only about one bath a week....so it's not wet that often....and it's majorly discolored and looks disgusting.  I'm guessing it's a weird mildew?  But this was a waste.  Throwing this one away and looking for pillow like i had for years before.  Disappointed.  Especially b/c it is comfortabl

I was disappointed in this bath pillow. When I removed it from the packaging it had a strong chemical odor. I had to leave it outside all day to get rid of the odor. The covering is not very soft unless it gets wet and the suction cups slip when they get wet. I will continue to use it because it is comfortable but I would not purchase it again.

overall this is one of the better bath pillows. I have purchased many that are the blow up type. that float and work for a short while. one way or another those type tend to get a hole and no longer are useable. That problem does not exist with this pillow. I love that it is a cushion type material. the downfall is that it soaks up water and becomes heavy. the suction cups eventually pop loose from the tub and it no longer stays in place. after use it dries quickly and has the hook that can be u

I found this pillow comfortable.  I like to lay in the tub, Because of my back, as well as not having enough at the base of the tub to lay back my head (it would be up against the wall) I use this pillow on the side and put my head on the side of the tub and lean by shoulder against that wall of the tub that faces out.  It is smooth but the suction cups do not hold very well.  I know this is peculiar rating, as I use the pillow differently than most.  Still, it is better than the rolled up towel

I don’t know how I’ve gone my entire adult life without this bath pillow :O It totally changes the experience and I personally have some OCD with people using a rolled up towel as pillow so then the towel is soaking wet and so on lol (my issue) but this pillow is the perfect solution. I’ve used it several times now and it’s holding up like new. The hook to hang it so it dries is fantastic as well and in overall it’s a very well thought out product. Kuddos on this!!:D

reviews.t: Not as good as I originally thought.
reviews.x: UPDATE:  If you take long baths, you are likely to find this uncomfortable, and if you have sensitive skin, likely unusable.  Also, it has a red ... Algae (???) growth that I have tried to wash out twice.  If this last time doesn't work (currently in the washer).  I may just pour in some bleach.  Because of spinal injuries and such, I often take long baths to soak in. I have never used a cushion before, but this one works very well for those long soaks.

reviews.t: Not Big Enough and Doesn't Grip Well
reviews.x: I really wanted to love this bath pillow after reading some of the positive reviews--especially the ones about it gripping well. However, I find that I am constantly trying to keep it in place and it just isn't as cushy nor as large as the pillows I've bought in the past (other brands). The ones I bought in the past also gripped much better and weren't slipping around all the time. I also am not happy that the head rest part of the pillow isn't larger.

I had a great tub pillow for YEARS. I was hoping this one would be a great replacement as I had slashed the other one while opening a box after moving. This one has no suction power. Even when sitting against it, it slides all over. It's too narrow (right to left), too short (top to bottom) and I'm skinny (size small). It's all around junk. Looking for something else. ETA: I had 2 stars. I've updated to 1 because now the pillow is mildewy.

reviews.t: I like everything about this bath pillow!!
reviews.x: Can't think of anything I dislike about this bath pillow!  I use it many nights during the week to soak in an Epsom Salt tub.  It's extremely comfortable such that I dose off in the tub on many of those nights. It is generous in size, providing ample support for my back and neck. It dries quickly after a soak too. Very nice pillow and I would not hesitate to purchase another one for myself. It would also make a lovely gift.

Absolutely no issues! Works exactly as described! I was a little skeptical at first because of the mesh-like design, but it dries well and it's pretty comfortable! Pictures makes it seem a bit bigger than it is, but it's still a good size (I'm terrible at visualizing size). Never had any issues with the suction cups, drying, or any sort of lingering smells. Overall, would recommend and would buy again! <3

reviews.t: Would not recommend, save your money.
reviews.x: I wanted this pillow for so long and finally pulled the trigger. Unfortunately I found that even after hanging the pillow to dry, and washing it after ever two uses, it remained gross. The bottom half of the pillow holds a permanent orangey tint and I’m now too grossed out to use it. I’ve tried stain remover sprays, soaking in oxy clean, etc. I would not purchase again, save your money.

This pillow is comfortable and the mesh on the outside of it helps scrub the back. But this doesn't make it uncomfortable to lay against, it is still comfy. The suction cups hold well but are easy to take off. My only complaint is after using it, it's hard to get all the water out without hanging it up above the tub to drain.

So, I hope you don't make the mistake I did and think that the picture they advertise is how it will look! I hope you read the reviews and look at their pictures so see how small this actually is! Other than the misleading picture, it is very puffy and comfortable... hoping it doesn't yellow but haven't used enough to know.

It's cheap, sticks, and dries fine. Not much more you could ask for. The hook to hang it up for drying on the shower curtain rod is a nice feature.  Update: I've been having some trouble getting it to stick recently but it stays in place if you're actively laying on it, just not if you move around too much.

reviews.t: So comfy! I love it! Dries fast. Nice hook to hang it upZ
reviews.x: This is a lovely pillow that is making my bath so much better! I have missed my last bath pillow. Using a towel didn’t fit it.  Ik super glad I bought this  The hook to hang it up with is a nice touch!  Will update if there are any problems. I won’t use it with oil in the water to void staining.

My husband liked this pillow (I bought it for him since he enjoys taking baths). Suction cups mostly worked but it took some tries to make them work on the surface we have, it’s not completely flat so it wasn’t easy right away. The pillow is soft, large enough and dries well

This pillow is so comfy. I've never been able to doze off whilst bathing, until now. The suction cups have to be messed around with but once they're good, they won't move. It airs out super nicely and love that it has  little hook. I'm pleased with performance and price.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the pillow comfortable and supportive for the back and neck.
Several reviewers praise the fast-drying fabric and the built-in hook for hanging it up.
Suction is a common concern: some say the six suction cups hold well, while others report it slipping or not sticking.
A number of reviewers report mold, mildew, or discoloration developing within a short time.
Some reviewers note the fabric feels less soft or has a chemical odor, and that oils affect the suction.
